name: ITACA | 21 square channels | resolved NS + conjugate heat

provenance.cavity: User-supplied experimental description: diameter 104.92 mm, height 85 mm, solid-state generator 2350–2500 MHz.
provenance.supplement: Malhotra et al., Temperature Homogeneity under Selective and Localized Microwave Heating in Structured Flow Reactors, SI ie0c05580_si_001.pdf, pp. 1–5; supplied locally by user.
provenance.sample: Malhotra et al. (2021), DOI 10.1021/acs.iecr.0c05580, p.6838: 21 square 1.3 mm channels, 15 mm monolith length, 10 mm ID tube. The 5-by-5-minus-corners layout and 1.65 mm pitch are ASSUMED; actual channel centres were not tabulated.
provenance.material: SI uses k=50 W/(m K). Main-paper Figure 9 gives epsilon*=9.72-2.3j at 300 K for a DIFFERENT 19-round-channel case. This file borrows that room-temperature value and holds it constant: an illustrative scenario, NOT a calibrated reproduction of the 21-channel experiment. No extra conductivity is added.
provenance.port: Radial ideal 50-ohm lumped probe; 8 mm length and mid-height position assumed. Actual coax dimensions, windows, and S11 calibration are unavailable. Main paper p. 6837 motivates impedance walls and first-order scattering boundaries at tube exits.
provenance.empty_cavity_loss: Main paper pp. 6837–6838 reports 7–11 W empty-tube accepted power and an 8 ± 1 W comparison offset; this is recorded as evidence, not subtracted automatically from loaded runs.
provenance.flow: 3D P2/P1 incompressible laminar Navier-Stokes, equal flow split among identical straight channels, no-slip walls, smooth inlet profile, zero natural outlet traction. Constant rho/mu at reference_temperature_c; heating changes thermal conductivity and EM properties but not flow density/viscosity. No inlet/outlet manifold CFD.

material.name: SiC solid, illustrative constant dielectric extension
